title: Past continuous and past simple - Narrative tenses introduction

options.answer: She watched TV when I called her.
She was watching TV when I called her.
She was watched TV when I called her.

explanation.en: We use past continuous for an action in progress when another action interrupted it. The correct form is 'was watching' (past continuous) + 'called' (past simple).
explanation.ru: Мы используем прошедшее продолженное время для действия в процессе, когда другое действие его прервало. Правильная форма: 'was watching' (прошедшее продолженное) + 'called' (прошедшее простое).
explanation.uz: Boshqa harakat uni to'xtatganda davom etayotgan harakat uchun past continuous ishlatiladi. To'g'ri shakl: 'was watching' (past continuous) + 'called' (past simple).

options.answer: While I was reading, the phone was ringing.
While I was reading, the phone rang.
While I read, the phone was ringing.

explanation.en: Use past continuous for the longer background action and past simple for the interrupting action. 'While I was reading' (background) and 'the phone rang' (interruption).
explanation.ru: Используйте прошедшее продолженное для более длительного фонового действия и прошедшее простое для прерывающего действия. 'While I was reading' (фон) и 'the phone rang' (прерывание).
explanation.uz: Uzunroq fon harakati uchun past continuous, to'xtatuvchi harakat uchun past simple ishlatiladi. 'While I was reading' (fon) va 'the phone rang' (to'xtatish).

options.answer: Yesterday at 3 PM, I was working in the garden.
Yesterday at 3 PM, I worked in the garden.
Yesterday at 3 PM, I work in the garden.

explanation.en: Past continuous is used for actions in progress at a specific time in the past. 'At 3 PM' indicates a specific time, so 'was working' is correct.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее продолженное используется для действий в процессе в определенное время в прошлом. 'At 3 PM' указывает на конкретное время, поэтому 'was working' правильно.
explanation.uz: O'tmishda ma'lum vaqtda davom etgan harakatlar uchun past continuous ishlatiladi. 'At 3 PM' aniq vaqtni ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun 'was working' to'g'ri.

options.answer: They were playing football when it was starting to rain.
They were playing football when it started to rain.
They played football when it was starting to rain.

explanation.en: Past continuous describes the ongoing action 'were playing' and past simple describes the interrupting event 'started to rain'.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее продолженное описывает продолжающееся действие 'were playing', а прошедшее простое описывает прерывающее событие 'started to rain'.
explanation.uz: Past continuous davomli harakatni 'were playing' tasvirlaydi, past simple esa to'xtatuvchi voqeani 'started to rain' tasvirlaydi.

options.answer: She was cooking dinner, washed the dishes, and was cleaning the kitchen.
She cooked dinner, washed the dishes, and cleaned the kitchen.
She was cooking dinner, was washing the dishes, and cleaned the kitchen.

explanation.en: For a sequence of completed actions in the past, use past simple for all verbs. These are finished actions that happened one after another.
explanation.ru: Для последовательности завершенных действий в прошлом используйте прошедшее простое время для всех глаголов. Это завершенные действия, которые произошли одно за другим.
explanation.uz: O'tmishda tugallangan harakatlar ketma-ketligi uchun barcha fe'llar uchun past simple ishlatiladi. Bu birin-ketin sodir bo'lgan tugallangan harakatlar.

options.answer: When I was arriving home, I saw my friend.
When I arrived home, I saw my friend.
When I was arrive home, I saw my friend.

explanation.en: Both actions 'arrived' and 'saw' are completed actions that happened in sequence, so both use past simple tense.
explanation.ru: Оба действия 'arrived' и 'saw' - это завершенные действия, которые произошли последовательно, поэтому оба используют прошедшее простое время.
explanation.uz: Ikkala harakat ham 'arrived' va 'saw' ketma-ket sodir bo'lgan tugallangan harakatlar, shuning uchun ikkalasi ham past simple ishlatadi.

options.answer: It was raining heavily while we walked to school.
It was raining heavily while we were walking to school.
It rained heavily while we were walking to school.

explanation.en: Both actions were happening at the same time in the past, so both verbs use past continuous: 'was raining' and 'were walking'.
explanation.ru: Оба действия происходили одновременно в прошлом, поэтому оба глагола используют прошедшее продолженное: 'was raining' и 'were walking'.
explanation.uz: Ikkala harakat ham o'tmishda bir vaqtda sodir bo'lgan, shuning uchun ikkala fe'l ham past continuous ishlatadi: 'was raining' va 'were walking'.

options.answer: Last night at 10 o'clock I was studied for my exam.
Last night at 10 o'clock I was studying for my exam.
Last night at 10 o'clock I studied for my exam.

explanation.en: Past continuous is formed with was/were + verb-ing. The correct form is 'was studying', not 'was studied'.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее продолженное образуется с помощью was/were + глагол-ing. Правильная форма - 'was studying', а не 'was studied'.
explanation.uz: Past continuous was/were + fe'l-ing bilan tuziladi. To'g'ri shakl 'was studying', 'was studied' emas.

options.answer: We were having dinner when the doorbell was ringing.
We were having dinner when the doorbell rang.
We had dinner when the doorbell rang.

explanation.en: Use past continuous for the ongoing action 'were having dinner' and past simple for the interrupting action 'rang'.
explanation.ru: Используйте прошедшее продолженное для продолжающегося действия 'were having dinner' и прошедшее простое для прерывающего действия 'rang'.
explanation.uz: Davomli harakat uchun past continuous 'were having dinner' va to'xtatuvchi harakat uchun past simple 'rang' ishlatiladi.

options.answer: The children was playing in the garden when their mother called them.
The children were playing in the garden when their mother called them.
The children were played in the garden when their mother called them.

explanation.en: 'Children' is plural, so use 'were' not 'was'. Past continuous is formed with were + playing, not 'were played'.
explanation.ru: 'Children' - множественное число, поэтому используйте 'were', а не 'was'. Прошедшее продолженное образуется с were + playing, а не 'were played'.
explanation.uz: 'Children' ko'plik, shuning uchun 'was' emas, 'were' ishlatiladi. Past continuous were + playing bilan tuziladi, 'were played' bilan emas.
